advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 22.69; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.186 over 24 corners (12 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.36 / R 0.42; 3/9 stops locked both

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 525 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Mixed axle signal — 10 front-limited vs 6 rear-limited of 24 corners. Not enough agreement for a balance call: repeat the same corner type several times before changing anything.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 9 stops (3 both-axle, 3 front-first, 4 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.49) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
